schema.description:
Body of `POST /v1/utm/generate` (all fields optional - each absent field
falls back to its handler default).

base_url.description:
Booking base URL the link is built on
(default `https://book.example.com`).

utm_content.description: Appended to the link only when non-empty.

utm_term.description: Appended to the link only when non-empty.

schema.title: UtmGenerateRequest
